Cf. Duryodhanasuta, Kuruśārdūla.
Lakshmaṇāgraja (“elder brother of Lakshmaṇa^1”) = Rāma Dāśarathi: VII, 2226.
Lakshmaṇamātṛ (“mother of Lakshmaṇa^2”) = the wife of Duryodhana: IX, 3618; XI, 511, 524.
